label: Built
quote: It may have been built by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka, but it is generally dated slightly later to the 2nd century BCE.

label: Enlargements
value: Enlarged five times, each time over the last
quote: The stupa was enlarged on five occasions during the following centuries

label: Excavated
quote: led by archaeologist Domenico Faccenna from 1956

label: Dating
value: A coin of Chandragupta Maurya in the oldest core
quote: The oldest core strata (GSt 1) revealed a coin of Chandragupta Maurya

label: What to see
value: An in-situ seated Buddha (or Bodhisattva) statue, thought one of the earliest in NW India
quote: The in-situ seated Buddha (or Bodhisattva) statue at Butkara is considered one of the earliest, if not the earliest, known iconographical statues of the Buddha in northwestern India.

label: Where finds are kept
value: A large quantity of the artifacts, in Turin (M.A.O.)
quote: A large quantity of the artifacts are preserved in the National Museum of Oriental Art and the City Museum of Ancient Oriental Art in Turin (M.A.O.).
